origins.section: Next Year's PoF Is Conditional on the Asset Working Today
The Hazard Is the Failure Rate Among the Assets Still Working
Beta Is the Shape, and Eta Is the Age by Which 63% Have Failed

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-conditional-pof: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-conditional-pof: 7.3.1 'Next Year's PoF Is Conditional': "PoF(a) = ... (F(a+1) - F(a))/R(a)"; "A yearly PoF for an asset in service is always the conditional". With beta 3, eta 40, R(50) is about 0.14.
recorded.prompt:q-shape-below-one: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-shape-below-one: "beta < 1: the hazard falls with age ... Replacing such an asset with a new one raises its risk."
recorded.prompt:q-scale-share: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-scale-share: "Whatever the shape, 63.2% of a fleet has failed by age eta." F(eta) is 0.632 in every row.

recorded.prompt:q-conditional-pof:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-conditional-pof:a: "The unconditional column ... is badly wrong for old ones"; F(a+1)-F(a) is for a new fleet, not a standing asset.
recorded.prompt:q-conditional-pof:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-conditional-pof:b: "The cumulative distribution is not a yearly PoF" ... "it is not the chance of failing during year y".
recorded.prompt:q-conditional-pof:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-conditional-pof:d: "A hazard is a rate, not a probability." ... "so it can exceed 1".
recorded.prompt:q-shape-below-one:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-shape-below-one:b: Same passage: when beta < 1 the hazard falls with age, so old cables do not fail at a higher rate.
recorded.prompt:q-shape-below-one:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-shape-below-one:c: A flat hazard is the beta = 1 case ("the hazard is constant"), not 0.8.
recorded.prompt:q-shape-below-one:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-shape-below-one:d: The hazard is a power of age, and for beta < 1 it "falls with age". No peak at the scale.
recorded.prompt:q-scale-share:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-scale-share:a: "Whatever the shape, 63.2% ... by age eta": K also reaches 63% at the scale.
recorded.prompt:q-scale-share:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-scale-share:b: Same passage: L also reaches 63% at its scale, whatever its shape.
recorded.prompt:q-scale-share:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-scale-share:c: Eta "is not the average life and not the median". 63% is reached at eta, not at the mean.
